commit_message: Preserve ACP MCP permission identity and terminal run state
pr_title: GameEngine: preserve ACP MCP permission identity
pr_body:
## Summary

- retain provider-declared stable GameEngine MCP tool identity across ACP tool-call and permission events instead of authorizing from opaque call IDs or coarse ToolKind alone
- normalize claimed GameEngine MCP names against the canonical Editor MCP inventory and shared read/write classifier, while keeping unknown or malformed identities fail-closed
- distinguish host policy rejection from explicit user denial when resolving ACP permission options
- make provider turn return terminal when completion gates remain unsatisfied so AI Studio cannot remain indefinitely Executing
- add regression coverage and document the permission/terminal-state contract in ADR 0166

## Validation

Request Windows affected validation for the engine-editor scope. This is ACP/Agent Host logic and documentation only; no visual-layout change is intended.
